title: 第一卷第5章 你的桀骜不驯呢恢复一下第一卷第6章 危机四阶妖兽
content_zh:
“他娘的！”
“本君的手怎么就那么欠！”
“没事儿碰那把破剑做什么！”
意识空间深处。
一座方圆丈许的剑牢内。
一道看不清面目的黑影呆愣愣地看着面前的囚牢，语气中满是绝望和悔恨。
“这下倒好！”
“待在这么个鬼地方，本君不知要等到何时才能脱困而出了！”
他不是没试过冲击剑牢。
只不过。
这剑牢虽然看似平平无奇，可每当他想要冲出去，便会有一道纯粹剑意落下，将他的魂力削去一部分。
先前。
只是数次碰撞。
这道残魂的魂力便被削去了足足三分之一，他自然不敢再轻易尝试。
“唉！”
他悔恨无比。
看到剑意的刹那，他就明白。
别说他只剩下了一道残魂，就算是他原身在此，修为处在巅峰，也绝对挡不住那几乎能把大道都斩断的一剑！
“太贪心了！”
“早知道，就选择先前那叫顾天的了！”

“虽然他资质差得一塌糊涂，肉身也跟本君不太契合，可……总比困在这个鬼地方强得多！”
“难道……”
良久之后，他颓然一叹，大手缓缓张开，一枚神异的金印静静躺在手心。
“这东西，真的跟本君无缘了吗？”
“都怪那个小王八蛋！”
看到金印。
他就想起了顾寒。
“他娘的！”
“明明身边有如此逆天的剑道传承，还被人打成了那副德性，真是个废物！自己废物就不说了，还害得本君也跟着着了道！”
破口大骂间。
他又有些遗憾。
“可惜了，他那副肉身与本君还是极为契合的……”
“你手里拿的。”
冷不防。
一道冷冷的声音自他背后响起。
content_en:
"Damn it!"
"Why are my hands so weak!"
"What are you doing with that broken sword?"
Deep in the space of consciousness.
In a sword prison with a radius of about ten feet.
A dark figure with an unclear face stared blankly at the prison in front of him, his tone full of despair and regret.
"This is a good time!"
"Staying in such a hellish place, I don't know how long it will take before I can escape!"
It's not like he has never tried to attack the sword prison.
only.
Although this sword prison seemed ordinary, every time he tried to rush out, a pure sword intent would fall down, cutting off part of his soul power.
previously.
Just a few collisions.
The soul power of this remnant soul had been reduced by a full third, so naturally he did not dare to try it again.
"Alas!"
He was extremely remorseful.
The moment he saw the sword's intention, he understood it.
Not to mention that he only has a remnant soul left. Even if his original body is here and his cultivation is at its peak, he will never be able to block the sword that can almost cut off the avenue!
"Too greedy!"
"If I had known better, I would have chosen the one named Gu Tian!"
"Although his qualifications are completely inferior, and his physical body is not very suitable for me, but... it is still much better than being trapped in this hellish place!"
"Could it be..."
After a long time, he sighed dejectedly, slowly opened his big hand, and a magical golden seal lay quietly in the palm of his hand.
"Is this thing really irrelevant to me?"
"It's all that little bastard's fault!"
See the gold seal.
He thought of Gu Han.
"Damn it!"
"You obviously have such a heaven-defying swordsmanship inheritance around you, and yet you were beaten into such a bad character. What a waste! Not to mention that you are a waste, but you also caused me to follow suit!"
While shouting curses.
He felt a little regretful.
"It's a pity, his physical body is very suitable for me..."
"You have it in your hand."
Suddenly.
A cold voice sounded from behind him.
